color.note: Light theme only. Every UI color is a true grey (r = g = b) so swatches read true; the user's palette is the only strong color on screen.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Off-white with no hue tint.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, sheets and the swatch grid ground. Swatches sit on surface, never on a tint.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Image and face slots, skeleton bars, pressed ghost buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card edges on paper. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, quiz options): 3.2:1 on paper, 3.4:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on paper, surface and sunken. Also the focus ring, the selected quiz option and the current progress step.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, hex codes, on paper, surface and sunken (6:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, overlines and disabled labels, on paper, surface and sunken (4.6:1 or more). Never body copy.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one functional accent: the primary button fill, nothing else. A low-saturation graphite, so it never competes with a swatch.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed fill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on accent and accent-strong fills (about 10:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons (with a word, never color alone), on surface, paper and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error note, behind danger text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons (with a word, never color alone), on surface, paper and success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a success note, behind success text.

tokens.name: swatch-edge
tokens.usage: 1px inner edge on every swatch chip, so near-white colors still show their shape on surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Veil over locked report content in the teaser.

tokens.name: sample-terracotta
tokens.usage: Demo data for previews and the cover only (a Soft Autumn palette). Never UI chrome.

tokens.name: sample-olive
tokens.usage: Demo data for previews and the cover only. Never UI chrome.

tokens.name: sample-camel
tokens.usage: Demo data for previews and the cover only. Never UI chrome.

tokens.name: sample-teal
tokens.usage: Demo data for previews and the cover only. Never UI chrome.

tokens.name: sample-rose
tokens.usage: Demo data for previews and the cover only. Never UI chrome.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The season name on the reveal and the share card. One per screen.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: One-line season summary under the season name.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: One selfie in daylight. Two minutes.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a screen title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Natural light from a window works best.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Shot near a window, no filter

styles.name: hex
styles.usage: Hex codes under swatches; uppercase, tabular figures (bundle.css).

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section kicker above a heading; uppercase (bundle.css), ink-muted.

spacing.note: 4px base. Screen gutter is space-4 (16px), leaving 343px of content on a 375px phone.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Chip to its label, icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a swatch (chip, name, hex); swatch grid row gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Swatch grid column gap; gap between stacked buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter, left and right.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen padding top and bottom; between blocks inside a report section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a heading and the content it introduces on hero screens.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between report sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top of a reveal screen, above the season name.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Swatch chips, image slots inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, quiz options, notes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, report sections, the share card frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and badges.

shadow.note: Hairlines over shadows. Shadows only lift things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Selected quiz option, the locked card.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: The share card preview, sheets.

tokens.name: size-tap
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every control: buttons, inputs, quiz options.

tokens.name: size-column
tokens.usage: Max content width of flow screens (photo, quiz, result) on wider screens: they stay a single phone column.

tokens.name: size-page
tokens.usage: Max content width of the two wide pages, landing and full report, from 1024px up (.sn-page).
